rawProductJson.name: Summit Creatorbook Pro
rawProductJson.description: The Summit Creatorbook Pro. A dependable laptops pick with a clean, no-nonsense design and the everyday features you actually use.

specs.inTheBox: Creatorbook, Recovery key card, Quick-start guide, Power cord

reviews.author: Imran S.
reviews.title: Worth every rupee
reviews.body: Replaced a five-year-old unit with this. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Summit seem to have got this one right. Happy to recommend it.

reviews.author: Tanvi C.
reviews.title: Worth every rupee
reviews.body: Replaced a five-year-old unit with this. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Summit seem to have got this one right. Would buy the same one again.

reviews.author: Rohan D.
reviews.title: Worth every rupee
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Build quality is genuinely good for the price. Summit seem to have got this one right. Would buy the same one again.

reviews.author: Rhea D.
reviews.title: No complaints at all
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Matches the listing description exactly. Happy to recommend it.

reviews.author: Gaurav R.
reviews.title: Worth every rupee
reviews.body: Replaced a five-year-old unit with this. Build quality is genuinely good for the price. Packaging was tidy and nothing was missing. No regrets.

reviews.author: Karthik G.
reviews.title: Solid, boring, reliable
reviews.body: Replaced a five-year-old unit with this. Setup took under ten minutes with no surprises. Second Summit product I own and both have lasted. Holding up well so far.

reviews.author: Meera R.
reviews.title: No complaints at all
reviews.body: Bought this after returning two other brands. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Matches the listing description exactly. Holding up well so far.
